about:
Michigan Fiber Optic LLC operates from Holton, Michigan, serving businesses, communities, and homeowners across the state. The company's team brings three decades of experience in fiber optic installation, splicing, and network design, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end fiber optic services, including design, cable placement, installation, splicing, termination, testing, and turn-up. Its technicians handle all fiber types—single mode, multimode, ribbon, and tube—in both inside and outside plant environments. The company also offers structured cabling solutions such as Cat5, Cat6, and Wi-Fi system deployment, positioning itself as a single-source provider for fiber projects of any scale.

Customers range from residential homeowners and local businesses to municipal networks and community broadband initiatives. Michigan Fiber Optic responds to emergency repair requests 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, restoring service after cable cuts or outages. Its OTDR testing capability pinpoints faults ranging from minor bends to complete breaks, enabling targeted repairs.

The company emphasizes its readiness—crews are fully trucked and tooled for immediate deployment—and its comprehensive project management from initial design through final turn-up. This turnkey approach, combined with deep field experience, is presented as its core differentiator in the Michigan market.
